# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.3

## 2026-08-23

## Fixed

- Media readiness no longer reports "blocked" when the smartphone forwarding
  state simply cannot be read. The select's internal "unknown" placeholder was
  scored like a real non-Home-Assistant mode, so a device whose forwarding was
  merely unreadable looked misconfigured.
- The Repair issues for media setup, the Home Assistant media user and the
  device QML hook can appear at all again. They were gated on a check that
  answered "video disabled" for every real installation, so none of them could
  ever be raised -- including the media-user guidance referenced in earlier
  support threads.
- The delete buttons keep their entity settings across restarts. The same
  faulty check made the stale-entity cleanup run on every start, removing the
  registry entries for the video-message and memo delete buttons, which the
  button platform then re-created without any rename, area or hidden flag.
- A device with no smartphone pairing is reported as its own setup failure
  instead of being told to switch forwarding to Home Assistant, which is not
  something that can be switched on such a device.
- A forwarding push that cannot be parsed no longer clears the known state, and
  the `smartphone_forwarding_changed` event reports the pushed mode rather than
  the previously stored one, so automations are not handed a stale value as a
  change.

## Changed

- The diagnostics download now answers media problems on its own: the
  media-readiness verdict with the forwarding state in plain text, how the
  media-user setup switch is registered, the four agent fields the report
  previously dropped -- among them the reason a media session was refused --
  and the video-bridge counters showing how far an RTSP attempt got, whether
  the agent refused it and why, and whether any media ever arrived.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- The native C300X device agent is unchanged from `1.9.2`; no agent update is
  required for this Home Assistant-only release.
- If you keep the C300X display integration switched off in the integration
  options while a Display patch is active, the three delete buttons are no
  longer created. They were only present because the option could not be read;
  enable the option to get them back.
